title: Grateful Dead Live at Oregon Country Fair on 1982-08-28
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/44.1k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 (With Bass EQ) -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell XLIIS/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Outstanding audience recording captures a blistering set with a smoking Wheel > Other One > Truckin’ sequence and an all‑time great Althea.
ai_review.review: The audience tape is praised for its vivid, immersive sound that many reviewers say even surpasses the soundboard in authenticity. Musically the show is described as "blistering" with a standout Wheel → The Other One → Truckin' stretch and an unforgettable performance of Althea, delivering high energy throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently glowing 5‑star comments highlight both a superb musical performance and an excellent audience recording; the weighted average of show (≈5) and recording quality (≈4.5) yields a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note vivid, immersive sound that captures the live atmosphere; no complaints about muddiness or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy first set with a smoking Wheel > Other One > Truckin' sequence; Althea highlighted as an all‑time favorite.
